articles.summary: APAC-focused K25.ai closes a Pre-A round at a $100M valuation, as Nasdaq-listed NewGenIVF invests $2M with an option up to $10M and supports APAC growth.
articles.title: K25.ai, Led by Tech Veteran Andy Cheung, Eyes Public Listing as World's First Prediction Market After $100M Valuation Investment from Nasdaq-Listed Strategic Partner
